Portal.title: Attendance Portal
Portal.description: A self-serve company attendance portal with branding, hashed role passwords, user-configured Realtime Database connection, and shared email access list.

id.description: Unique portal identifier matching document ID

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the portal creator

ownerEmail.description: Normalized lowercase email of the portal creator

ownerName.description: Display name of the portal creator

companySubtitle.description: Optional registered office address or short tagline

companyLogo.description: Optional compressed company logo data URL (PNG/JPEG/WebP)

adminHash.description: SHA-256 salted hash of the Admin role password

supervisorHash.description: SHA-256 salted hash of the Supervisor role password

inchargeHash.description: SHA-256 salted hash of the Site In-Charge role password

rtdbProjectId.description: Firebase project ID extracted from the Realtime Database URL

backupRtdbUrl.description: Optional secondary Firebase Realtime Database URL for 15-day backup mirroring

storageBucket.description: Optional Firebase Storage bucket for site photo backups

sharedWithEmails.description: Bounded list (max 50) of verified lowercase recipient emails with access to this portal

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the portal was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the portal was last updated

PortalShare.title: Portal Share Invitation
PortalShare.description: Audit record of sharing a portal with a verified recipient email address.

id.description: Deterministic share ID combining portalId and recipient hash

ownerUid.description: UID of the portal owner who created the share

ownerEmail.description: Lowercase email of the portal owner

recipientEmail.description: Verified lowercase email of the recipient

companyName.description: Company name snapshot for share audit log

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the share was granted

/portals/{portalId}.description: Multi-tenant attendance portal configurations owned by a user and shared with verified team emails.

/portalShares/{shareId}.description: Individual email share records linked to a parent portal, created and revoked atomically with the parent portal sharedWithEmails list.
